en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river valley with a bend in the river, steep terraced slopes on the right (likely vineyards), and a clustered settlement of small houses along the riverbank. In the foreground is a large multi‑storey masonry building and, closer to the river, several gabled houses; one bears a sign identifying it as a restaurant. The opposite bank is largely open fields and trees, and a road follows the river on the right side. The scene has the appearance of an early‑20th‑century European riverside town.
